name: Heart & Soles
source:
This is a visual novel that takes place on a distant planet when two young princes' go to a University for other star seeds, there they meet a few uncommon friends with a shared desire for foot paws and foot wear. this is a deeply intimate and romantic tale of how these star crossed lovers find true happiness and acceptance with themselves and each other welcome to Sole Mates may you find yours here.

[From [url=https://ari-blackwolfe.itch.io/heartandsoles]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，故事发生在一个遥远的星球上，两位年轻的王子为了寻找其他星际种子而去一所大学，在那里他们遇到了一些不寻常的朋友，他们对脚爪和鞋子有着共同的渴望。这是一个非常亲密和浪漫的故事，讲述了这些命运多舛的恋人如何找到真正的幸福，并接受自己和彼此。欢迎来到Sole Mates，愿你在这里找到属于你的。

[来自[url=https://ari-blackwolfe.itch.io/heartandsoles]Itch.io[/url]]
